text:
Tessa Nolan: opened a small PR to harmonize function-calling examples across languages and add a short parser fallback note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5177 :wave:
Rajiv Menon: thanks Tessa. Which snippets are flaky in CI?
Tessa Nolan: snippet-ci flagged two issues: a missing language marker on a python fence and one JS example still using free-form output. I switched the JS to the recommended explicit action+args shape and added an "If non-JSON" micro-section.
Sam Ortega: Can you keep the inline schema minimal? We should link to the canonical schema page instead of copying everything.
Tessa Nolan: yep. Inline we show a tiny example: {"action":"summarize","args":{"max_len":100}} and a collapsed link to /docs/schema-toolcall.md. Also added a tiny balanced-brace helper for the fallback rather than a greedy regex.
Rajiv Menon: nice. Small nit: docs tone should avoid "must". Use "Prefer structured JSON output; if not possible, use the fallbacks below."
Tessa Nolan: updated wording. Also added one-line examples for Python, JS, and a short Ruby snippet so readers see consistent patterns. Kept each fenced block language specified so snippet extraction works.
docs-bot: snippet-ci commented on PR #5177  python-snippets: 1 failed (missing fence), js-snippets: 0 failed. Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/snippet/5177
Sam Ortega: I'll push a tiny patch to add the missing ```python tag and a brief comment explaining the helper is a toy fallback.
Tessa Nolan: thanks. After CI is green I'll merge and add a changelog bullet. If anyone wants a quick review ping me. :white_check_mark:
